answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit and build a reputation over a slow voyage of verified work before it can transact freely. Like a comet, a sybil swarm appears suddenly, but without history it cannot cross the river of trust: creating thousands of identities would mean locking up thousands of deposits and months of wasted compute. Honest agents earn their standing once; attackers must pay again for every fake identity, so flooding the network stops being profitable.
